# Character Reference Sheet: the Violet Pirate (sci-fi)

## Layout
One clean character reference sheet on a single canvas, seamless light neutral-grey studio background. No text, no labels, no watermark, no logos anywhere. Four views in one row at the same eye-level, each figure clearly separated:
1. FULL BODY, front view, relaxed confident stance.
2. FULL BODY, three-quarter rear view, showing the back of the armour.
3. FULL BODY, side view.
4. CLOSE-UP, head-and-shoulders portrait, cold calm expression, looking at camera.
The SAME woman in every view: identical face, hair and armour. Consistent proportions and scale.

## Subject
Young woman, early 20s, strikingly beautiful. Athletic, lithe build. Cold, composed, dangerous calm. A space pirate who has lived rough for years.

## Face and skin
Defined heart-shaped face, high cheekbones, full lips with a dark plum lipstick. Light-tan skin with visible pores, a light dusting of freckles across the nose and cheeks, fine peach-fuzz. Pale violet eyes. Natural, not airbrushed. A faint smudge of grime on one cheek.

## Face marking (present in ALL views)
A violet ink face tattoo of fine angular circuit-like glyphs across her left cheekbone and temple. Flat tattoo ink in the skin, matte, not glowing. Same pattern in every view.

## Hair
Long, thick, slightly wavy hair in deep violet, darker at the roots, worn loose with strands framing the face. No helmet.

## Armour (identical in every view)
Worn, battle-scarred sci-fi space-pirate armour in black and gunmetal steel. Fitted segmented chest plate and shoulder plates over a black flexible under-suit, segmented forearm guards, a heavy utility belt with pouches and a holstered sidearm, armoured thigh plates and heavy magnetic boots. The metal is scratched, dented and gritty: chipped dark paint showing bare steel at the edges, scorch marks, oil stains, old repairs with mismatched bolts. Tiny violet indicator lights glow faintly at the collar and the belt buckle. Functional, heavy, real.

## Style
Photoreal live-action rendering. Real skin with visible pores and fine facial hair, real scratched gunmetal with physical specular highlights, real worn fabric. No linework, no cel shading, no illustration, no anime rendering, no painterly brushwork. Sharp focus, fine film grain. Soft neutral studio key light for accurate colour across all views, even and reference-clean overall.

## Palette
Black, gunmetal, bare steel, with violet as the only accent colour (hair, eyes, face tattoo, indicator lights).

## Negatives
Keep the canvas clean: bare neutral-grey background, this one woman alone, nothing written on the image. The armour reads identical in all four views. Render photographically, as a real actor photographed on a real set.

## Aspect ratio
16:9
